description: Controls whatever parameter the mouse pointer is over, by voltage, by triggers or from a MIDI control.

params.text: Smooths the changes made to the hovered parameter, 0 to 5 seconds.
Sets how far each trigger moves the hovered parameter, 0% to 20% of that parameter's full range.

inputs.text: Sets the hovered parameter: in Differential mode each change of voltage is added to the parameter, in Absolute mode 0-10V maps onto its full range. A cable on INC or DEC leaves this port unread.
While this gate is high, changes made to the hovered parameter are ten times finer; holding Shift does the same.
Sets the smoothing of changes to the hovered parameter by voltage, in place of the SLEW knob.
A trigger moves the hovered parameter up by one step.
A trigger moves the hovered parameter down by one step.

outputs.text: Carries the value of the hovered parameter as a voltage; on Reduced only changes made by this module update it, on Continuous every change to the parameter does.

notes: several instances with different step sizes, or one with the fine gate held high, give coarse and fine control from different MIDI knobs.
nothing is controlled until the mouse pointer is over a parameter; the light at the top comes on while one is under it.
menu: IN-mode — Differential adds each change of the input voltage to the parameter, Absolute maps 0-10V onto its full range.
OUT-mode — Reduced updates the OUT port only on changes this module makes, Continuous updates it on every change to the parameter.
Status overlay — shows each parameter change in a strip across the bottom of the screen.
